definition.title: FUI Orbital Tracker
definition.desc: A deterministic three-satellite mission display layers front and occluded orbit halves, fading trails, an active-time telemetry typer, and a ground-station pass over a compact wireframe planet.
definition.seen: Seen in FUI dashboards and NASA mission interfaces
definition.html:

definition.prompt:
Build the v4 FUI Orbital Tracker with a native 232×168 compact preview and a separate complete 440×380 full composition. Preserve the full original seeded three-satellite orbital configurations, 36 trails, front/back occlusion, station passes, 22ms telemetry typer and active-time geometry. Keep all data, samples and operational schedules. Use shared dock actions Next satellite, Reset, minimum 11px optical type, neutral grey and one accent, no outer demo panel or private replay controls, and explicit reduced-motion feedback. Drag geometry converts fitted physical pixels to logical CSS units; FLIP retargets from painted rectangles and collapse uses grid rows. Follow MOTION_SYSTEM.md; loops/animations pause on caller, document and viewport holds. Return cleanup that aborts listeners and cancels scheduling, observers and owned animations. Every native v4 SVG retains its original bytes, root dimensions and reference slot; no design screenshot is tile art.
Accessibility: Native names track the actual SAT-07/08/09 badge, preserving the independent complete full satellite model. Preserve all v4 copy, geometry, assets, datasets, clocks and motion recipes above.
